seo.legalDescription: Legal information for mybestgame.lol, the pay-to-rank video game leaderboard.

rules.title: Rules
items: Game bids start at $1. Whole dollars only.
Every paid bid on the same game adds to its total. The more it stacks, the higher it climbs.
Sponsor bids are separate. They buy the sponsor spot on a game card — the highest paid bid holds it.
To take a spot that's already claimed, bid at least $1 above the current holder.
Bids last 30 days. When one expires, that amount comes off the game's total.
Only confirmed payments count. Abandoned checkouts never appear on the board.
All sales are final. Bids can't be refunded after payment is confirmed.
Your display name is optional. Add one and it'll show publicly on the board.
Rankings refresh in real time as bids are paid or expire.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: mybestgame.lol collects the minimum data needed to operate the leaderboard. When you place a bid, you may optionally provide a display name (handle). We do not require or store your email address. If you voluntarily enter text that looks like an email, it will be stored as your display name. Your IP address is processed transiently for rate limiting and Cloudflare Turnstile verification but is not persisted in our database.

sections.heading: Payment data
sections.body: All payments are processed by Polar.sh. We do not see, store, or have access to your credit card number, billing address, or other payment PII. Polar handles PCI compliance and payment security. We receive only a payment confirmation, order ID, and the metadata we attached (bid ID, game ID, amount).

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: We use the following third-party services: Polar.sh for payment processing; IGDB (via Twitch/Amazon) for game data; Cloudflare Turnstile for bot protection. Each service has its own privacy policy. We do not sell, rent, or share your data with advertisers or data brokers.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: mybestgame.lol does not set first-party tracking cookies. Cloudflare Turnstile may set a functional cookie required for bot verification. We use no analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.heading: Data displayed publicly
sections.body: If you provide a display name, it will be shown publicly on the leaderboard, activity feed, plaques, and contributor lists. If the name looks like an email address, we partially mask it (e.g., ab•••{'@'}domain.com). You can bid as Anonymous by leaving the name field empty.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Bid records (display name, bid amount, game, timestamps) are retained for the lifetime of the service for leaderboard integrity and audit purposes. Expired bids (30-day expiry) remain in our database with 'expired' status.

sections.heading: Your rights (GDPR / KVKK)
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data by emailing privacy{'@'}mybestgame.lol. We will respond within 30 days. Note: deleting bid data may affect leaderboard history.

sections.heading: Data location
sections.body: Our database is hosted on infrastructure operated by the service owner. Payment data is processed by Polar.sh in their infrastructure.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy inquiries: privacy{'@'}mybestgame.lol. Operator: mybestgame.lol.

sections.heading: Acceptance
sections.body: By using mybestgame.lol, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the site.

sections.heading: Service description
sections.body: mybestgame.lol is a pay-to-rank video game leaderboard. Users place monetary bids on games to rank them higher. Sponsor bids buy an advertising/sponsor spot on a game card. The service is provided as-is for entertainment purposes.

sections.heading: Bids and payments
sections.body: All bids are processed through Polar.sh. Only verified paid bids appear on the leaderboard. Bids expire 30 days after payment confirmation. All sales are final and non-refundable. We do not guarantee any specific rank outcome — your rank depends on other users' bids.

sections.heading: No accounts
sections.body: mybestgame.lol does not have user accounts. Bids are identified by an optional display name. There is no login, password, or profile system.

sections.heading: Sponsor content
sections.body: Sponsor bids include user-provided content (title, description, link, optional image URL). We reserve the right to remove sponsor content that is illegal, offensive, misleading, or violates third-party rights without refund.

sections.heading: No guarantees
sections.body: We do not guarantee uptime, availability, rank position, or that your bid will remain on the board for any specific duration beyond the 30-day expiry window. Bids may be affected by other users' bids, expiry, or service changes.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: mybestgame.lol is provided 'as is' without warranty. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the operator's total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid in the last 30 days. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

sections.heading: Modifications
sections.body: We may modify these terms at any time. Continued use constitutes acceptance. Material changes will be noted on the site.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. Disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Istanbul, Turkey.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions: privacy{'@'}mybestgame.lol. Operator: mybestgame.lol.

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is mybestgame.lol, operated as a personal project. Contact: privacy{'@'}mybestgame.lol.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: We process data on the basis of legitimate interest (operating the leaderboard service) and, where applicable, your consent (providing a display name). Payment processing is necessary for contract performance.

sections.heading: Data processed
sections.body: Display name (optional, user-provided), bid amount, game selection, timestamps, and transient IP for rate limiting. We do not process sensitive/special category data.

sections.heading: Recipients
sections.body: Polar.sh (payment processing), IGDB/Twitch (game data lookup), Cloudflare (Turnstile verification, hosting). No data is sold to third parties.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under GDPR (EU) and KVKK (Turkey), you have the right to: access your data, rectify inaccurate data, request erasure, restrict processing, data portability, and object to processing. Submit requests to privacy{'@'}mybestgame.lol. We respond within 30 days.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Bid data is retained for the operational life of the service. You may request deletion at any time.

sections.heading: International transfers
sections.body: Data may be processed outside the EU/Turkey by our service providers (Polar.sh, Cloudflare). Appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses) apply.

sections.heading: Complaints
sections.body: You may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (e.g., KVKK in Turkey, or your EU supervisory authority).

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: mybestgame.lol uses minimal cookies. We do not use analytics, advertising, or social media tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Essential cookies
sections.body: Cloudflare Turnstile may set a cookie required for bot verification. This is strictly necessary for the service to function and does not require consent under GDPR.

sections.heading: No optional cookies
sections.body: We do not set any optional, marketing, or preference cookies. There is no cookie consent banner because we only use strictly necessary cookies.

sections.heading: Third-party cookies
sections.body: When you proceed to Polar.sh checkout, their domain may set cookies for payment processing. Refer to Polar's cookie policy for details.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about cookies: privacy{'@'}mybestgame.lol.

sections.heading: No refunds
sections.body: All bids on mybestgame.lol are final and non-refundable once payment is confirmed by Polar.sh. By placing a bid, you acknowledge that you are paying for immediate inclusion on the leaderboard.

sections.heading: Why no refunds
sections.body: Bids directly affect the public leaderboard the moment they are confirmed. Refunding a bid would retroactively alter rankings and affect other users' positions. This policy ensures fairness for all participants.

sections.heading: Cancelled checkouts
sections.body: If you cancel or abandon the checkout before payment completes, no charge is made and no bid appears on the board. This is not a refund — no money was collected.

sections.heading: Bid expiry
sections.body: Bids automatically expire after 30 days. Expiry is not a refund — you received 30 days of leaderboard presence for your bid.

sections.heading: Disputes
sections.body: If you believe a payment was made in error or without your authorization, contact Polar.sh support directly as the payment processor. We are unable to issue refunds for authorized, completed transactions.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For billing questions: privacy{'@'}mybestgame.lol.
